title: Bound fixed-contact Type B to Type A port conversion
body:
## Result and scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The exact #7334 word and signed #7113 caller give a positive optimistic price for a Type B to Type A port conversion if the two additional native owners are charged as rank-one helper losses. Two exact gates close the tested routes. At hosted port 15, J1 has an order-four opposite-sign relative rotation. The Type A relative map has a square-zero difference from identity, so even wrappers cannot convert the unchanged contact. Separately supplying the 34 missing eight-axis body returns costs at least 34 H8. Even with free phase repair, the per-port delta is at most 4(H9−H8−1), below −0.04555967541857 raw units.

The scope leaves coupled body delivery, changed native contacts, and signed wrappers open. The comparator is #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace`, with #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.
